mapper.select: SELECT r.code FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.id
SELECT ur.user_id AS userId, r.code AS roleCode FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND ur.user_id IN #{id} ORDER BY ur.user_id, r.id
